💡 How to Pull LSEG Data in USD Directly (No FX Conversions Needed)

In your original Excel file, foreign commodities (such as BMD Palm Oil FCPOc3, Dalian Palm DCPc3, Dalian BO DBYc3, Matif Rapeseed COMc2, ICE Canola RSc2) were pulled in domestic currencies and converted via manual formulas using separate FX columns (MYR=, CNY=, EUR=, CAD=).

LSEG Workspace & Refinitiv Data Platform (RDP) provide native, verified USD conversion on the fly! By passing CURN:USD directly inside the HistoricalPricing formula or parameters={"CURN": "USD"} in Python, LSEG aligns the closing FX rate on every single trading session automatically.

1. Direct Excel Formula (Drop-in Replacement for Cell C2):

=_xll.RDP.HistoricalPricing(A4:A36, "CLOSE", "NBROWS:1300 INTERVAL:P1D CURN:USD SOURCE:RFV", , "TSREPEAT:NO CH:Fd RH:Timestamp", D3)

Notice CURN:USD inside the parameter string. This immediately pulls all 33 rows in USD directly. You can delete columns AR to BU and reference the output table directly!

2. Python SDK Code (lseg.data):

import lseg.data as ld ld.open_session(app_key="YOUR_APP_KEY") df = ld.get_history( universe=["FCPOc3", "DCPc3", "COMc2", "RSc2", "BOc2"], fields=["TR.CLOSEPRICE"], parameters={"CURN": "USD"}, start="2021-08-01", end="2026-10-26", interval="1D" )
